name: dev-flow
description: Conductor for the dev pipeline: routes a task through the right subset of the canonical chain (grill-me → to-prd → compass → heist → maestro → verify → code-review) by detecting its tier (bug / feature / architecture / client), prints the exact stages it will run and skip with reasons, confirms, then drives the sub-skills in order. Matches ceremony to stakes instead of running every stage every time.
